messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — dashboard pulse shows a weird cohort drop for last week's webinar traffic. Can @jamal pull top-line attribution by source? Also, is inbound routing sending those leads to S1 or S2? We saw funnel slippage and want to flag before the KPI review.

jamal: On it. Pulling the query now. Initial peek: organic RSVPs -> conv 8% but qualified leads 3%. Paid signups conv 12% but QL 2.5%. Looks like a routing mismatch + qualification filter differences.

alex: Could be routing TTL — mid-funnel leads are getting tagged as `nurture` and not routed to SDRs. I can flip the playbook to immediate routing for webhook `webinar_reg` for 24h to see if QL improves. Any capacity constraints?

priya: Noted. Also saw messaging A (event CTA: "Start free trial") outperformed B ("Book demo") on click-throughs during the live event. That could explain part of the conversion vs qualification delta — higher volume but lower intent. Recommend swapping retargeting creative.

tayla: Paid spend was ~18% higher that week; prospecting audience got noisy. CPL up ~22%. If we push more low-intent audiences we'll likely see high RSVPs but low QL — we should tighten lookalike thresholds.

dashbot: Snapshot: https://dash.redwood.ai/s/weekly/kpi/1744501234 — includes cohort table + source attribution + quick CSV export.

jamal: SQL I ran for the snapshot: ```SELECT source, count(*) as rsvps, sum(case when qualified then 1 else 0 end) as ql FROM webinar_signups WHERE event_date between '2026-03-15' and '2026-03-21' GROUP BY source;``` Rough numbers are in the dash link.

maria: Thanks. Plan: Alex — flip routing for 24h and monitor SDR queue. Priya — rotate creative to variant B for retargeting, measure 72h. Jamal — can you add a 3-slide breakout for the KPI review showing: 1) attribution split, 2) routing impact simulation, 3) quick recommendation?

alex: Flipping now. Adding failback rule to `dedicated-route` if SDR queue > 50. Will post a short log in this thread after 30m.

jamal: Will prepare the 3 slides and add a dashboard cohort: `webinar > 3 interactions` retention. Also flagging a source parity issue where UTM campaign mapping differs between GA and internal CRM — will include notes.

priya: I'll draft two ad copy variants and post in #marketing by 3pm. Headline options I'm testing: "Ship faster with Redwood" vs "Cut inference costs by 40%" — leaning to the second for retargeting.

tayla: Budget tweak pushed to the ad doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/ads/q2 — I lowered prospecting by 10% and boosted retargeting. Will monitor CPA.

maria: Great, sync at 10am KPI review. If anyone sees a severe drop before then @jamal please ping paging list and escalate. :thumbsup:
